en_set.hype: The village is lit at night, one of Japan's most famous winter images.

winter.en: The light-up runs only on a few January evenings, 17:30-19:30, and not in December.

unsure: Baby notes and block left as is: they are about the winter night, which is the only time this runs. The tip about bookings opening in October kept.
